eyebrow.zh: 到顶即停 · 请求不出本机 · 不挂后台 · 不回传数据
eyebrow.en: Stops at the cap · Stays on your machine · No background process · Phones nothing home

headline.zh:
给编码 Agent 设一道硬上限
到顶就停，下一条请求不出本机
headline.en:
A hard cap on what your coding agent can spend
— it stops at the line, before the next request leaves

sub.zh: 在项目根目录放一个 .fuse.toml，写上这项目最多花几美元。你的 claude、codex、aider 跑过夜循环时，累计花费一到上限就停——下一条请求直接在本机被挡回。不挂后台、不上云、不回传任何数据。一个会偷偷回传数据的熔断器，本身就是问题。
sub.en: Drop a .fuse.toml at your project root with a USD cap. When your claude, codex, or aider runs an overnight loop, the moment cumulative spend hits the cap it stops — the next request is turned back at your machine. No background process, no cloud, nothing phoned home. A kill-switch that phones home is itself the problem.

title.zh: 到顶就停，并发也冲不过上限
title.en: Stops at the cap — even under concurrent load

body.zh: 一个过夜循环里，几十条请求可能同时往外冲。agentfuse 在每条请求出门前都核对一次累计花费——到顶就挡回，不管同时有多少条在飞。以前有一类请求能让花费悄悄绕过上限，现在每一条都照算、照挡。没有“差一点没卡住”这种事。
body.en: In an overnight loop, dozens of requests can race out at once. agentfuse checks the running total before each one leaves — and turns back any that would cross the line, no matter how many are in flight. A kind of request that once let spend slip quietly past the cap is now counted and held like every other. There's no 'almost held' here.

chips: › 没有一种请求能绕过上限

title.zh: 不管你用哪家的模型，上限都一样
title.en: Same cap, whichever model you run

body.zh: 一份 .fuse.toml、一行 fuse run，管住你接的每一家模型服务。流式回复漏报花费时，agentfuse 在本地把花费补回来——绝不悄悄记一笔 $0，让上限形同虚设。这条本地估算是逐条校准过的：不管回复是流式吐出来的还是一次性返回的，估出来的花费都经得起对账。
body.en: One .fuse.toml, one fuse run — the cap holds across every model service you've configured. And when a streamed reply omits its usage, agentfuse reconstructs the cost locally — it never silently bills $0 and lets the cap drift. That local estimate is calibrated reply by reply: whether a response streams or comes back in one piece, the figured cost stands up to a recount.

chips: › 一份配置管所有模型服务

title.zh: 价格表在你本机，从不联网
title.en: Prices live on your machine, never fetched

body.zh: 模型价格内置在工具里，你可以按机器覆盖。agentfuse 从不联网取价——这是它能当熔断器的前提。fuse prices --diff 还会告诉你：你的本地覆盖里，哪些压住了已变动的默认值，哪些指向已经下架的模型。
body.en: Model prices ship inside the tool; you override them per machine. agentfuse never fetches a price over the network — that's the premise for a tool allowed to cut off your spend. fuse prices --diff shows which of your overrides shadow a default that has since moved, and which point at a model that has since been retired.

title.zh: 全部留在本机，三十秒能审完
title.en: Everything stays local — auditable in 30 seconds

body.zh: 花费只写在你本机的一个文件里，工具随你那条 Agent 命令一起退出，不挂后台。除了你配的那家模型服务，它不和任何东西通信。三十秒就能审完它会不会回传数据——一个会偷偷回传的熔断器，本身就是信任问题。
body.en: Spend is written to a single file on your machine; the tool exits with the agent command it wrapped — nothing lingers in the background. It talks to nothing but the model service you configured. You can audit in thirty seconds whether it phones anything home — a kill-switch that phones home is itself the trust problem.

headline.zh: 一行 .fuse.toml，守住每个项目的上限

sub.zh: 开源、MIT、无付费墙。在你本机给 Agent 设上限这件事，永不收费。
sub.en: Open source, MIT, no paywall. The act of capping your agent locally is never gated.

tag.zh: 给编码 Agent 花费装的本地熔断器
tag.en: The local kill-switch for coding-agent spend
